newsitem.title: UK: RPC launches cashcall to buy plastics firm.
newsitem.headline: RPC launches cashcall to buy plastics firm.

text.p: RPC Group Plc on Friday launched a 32.7 million stg rights issue to buy the plastics unit of Germany's Schmalbach-Lubeca for 160 million Deutsche marks (around 63 million stg)
The rights issue is a two-for-five cashcall priced at 142 pence per share. The acquisition of the plastics unit CPE will extend the group's position into continental Europe from the UK market.
CPE makes rigid plastic packaging at 12 factories in Germany, Belgium, Holland, the UK, Spain, Poland and Hungary. In the year ended December 31 1995 it had sales of 389 million marks
The deal will require shareholder approval by RPC, with an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for December 30.

The part of the purchase price not covered by the cashcall will be funded by bank facilities. The deal will be marginally earnings dilutive in the first full year after the acquisition but earnings enhancing thereafter.
Gearing for the enlarged group is seen remaining under 75 percent.
